title: SD: Arithmetic mean (x̄)
summary: Arithmetic mean of the current SD list: Σx divided by n.

body.text: x̄ is the arithmetic mean. After AC, recall it from S-VAR. The calculator uses [[modes/sd/sum]] and [[modes/sd/n]] to get it.

body.caption: The four values 2, 4, 6, 8 sit on a number line. Their balance point is the mean x̄ = 5.

items: MODE 4. If you were already in SD, SHIFT 9 → 1 (Stat) → EXE to clear the old list
body.title: On the calculator

body.caption: FreqOn stores three classes. The bar for 85 is four times as tall as 75, so the mean (~82.14) sits closer to 85 than to 75.

items: Confirm FreqOn in SETUP, then MODE 4
body.title: On the calculator

body.text: You can embed the mean in an expression while remaining in SD: SHIFT 2 1 × 2 EXE doubles x̄.
MATH ERROR if n = 0 (empty list). Press AC first if you were scrolling the STAT-data editor.
